## Use Gintronic in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Gintronic for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Gintronic', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Gintronic is available from Official Website.

[Official Website](https://www.atipofoundry.com/fonts/gintronic)

## About the Gintronic coding font

A modern, geometric programming font. Gintronic is a paid monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Gintronic is not hosted on Google Fonts. The specimen above renders in the real face when the font is installed on your device; if it is not installed, the page falls back to a standard monospace face so the layout stays intact. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Gintronic FAQ

### Is Gintronic free?

No. Gintronic is a commercial font, sold by its vendor.

### Does Gintronic support ligatures?

No. Gintronic has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Gintronic?

Gintronic is available from Official Website. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
